push.title: W 1-0 vs UK Chargers | You: 7.6 (worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.6 against UK Chargers. Rough one. Let's talk about it like grown-ups and then let it go.

THE GOOD
+ 2 key passes. You were the playmaker, the matchmaker and the good-time maker.
+ A goal against UK Chargers, your 5th straight match scoring. Right place, right time, right foot.
+ 5th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That right there is what good teammates do.
+ Misplaced passes 7, from 12 in your previous match. That's the reliable kind of good.
+ We beat UK Chargers 1-0. Wins taste better when everybody chipped in.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Habit to build: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost. You know you can.
- 71% passing (17 of 24). Quick one: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. Like riding a bike.
- That's your worst match performance of the season with a 7.6. We go again.
- You and PhogsToffees share this one: forcing passes. Tandem fix: give each other short options.
- Shots 2, down from your usual 5. Note to self, from me to you.

Training-ground special: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.

Hey, BellyTb1. Smile at the goalkeeper. It confuses 'em.

Learn it, then leave it. - Coach Lasso
